sources.title: LAION · Open AI research for everyone
sources.snippet: LAION is a non-profit organization making machine-learning datasets, tools, and models openly available for research and education.

sources.title: LAION Humaneness Voice Large: Open Two-Speaker Podcast TTS
sources.snippet: LAION has posted Humaneness Voice Large, NotebookLM Edition on Hugging Face, an open-weight text-to-speech model built for one job: turning a written two-person script into a podcast-style conversation. You give it the dialogue and two short voice recordings, and it returns the whole exchange as one audio file.
